english: Huh? Why I was pretending to be a boy?\nI feel like I explained that once...\nI'd rather you didn't worry about it.
Back then... sorry,\nI couldn't really join the conversation...
R-really? It's not an interesting story, but\nthere were... various reasons.
You really... want to know?\nIt's not a complicated reason...
Um, if it's hard to talk about...\nI'm not dying to hear it.
...Everyone already knows, so\nthere's no point hiding it...
I'm with the Dunois Company, you see.\nI'm there as their figurehead.
Do you know the Dunois Company...?\nIn my world they're number three\nin mass-production IS market share...
How does that... lead to dressing as a boy?
It's simple.\nOnly women can operate an IS.\nYou knew that?
So... what if a man could operate one?
That would... draw attention.
I entered IS Academy as the Dunois Company's\nfigurehead.
And... if possible,\nthat person told me to gather\nthe latest data.
So there you go.\nSimple story, right?
Though I didn't think I'd be found out\nthis easily.
But...
Did it have to be me...?\nRight?
That's simple too.\nIt just so happened my IS aptitude was high.
Even though they say only girls can use an IS,\nnot everyone can use one\nthe same way.
So naturally, they'd pick me\nwith my high aptitude.
See? The reason for the boy act\nis no big deal, right?
But... you look sad.\nIf I'm imagining it... then good.
...It's... nothing.\nDon't worry about it, ahaha.
...Mmm... sharp...
I see.
...You just say 'I see' to a girl\nwho was dressing as a boy... normally...
So, are your questions answered?\nI need to maintain my IS.
Even as a personal-unit holder, it's a lot of work.
No, sorry for stopping you.\nI'm fine now.
Got it.\nIf you want to ask anything else,\njust say so.
(Charles-san seems like such an honor student...\nNo edge to her at all...)
Charles-san?\nIs something wrong?
No. It's nothing.
Did I look down?\nI'm really fine.
Even just for now, I want to spend\nsome happy time...
'Just for now'... what do you mean?\nIs it something with the Dunois Company?
...Wow.\nAre you psychic or something?\nDifferent worlds really have unusual people.
Right now, it's fine.\nBeing moved to another world is\npretty wild, after all.
But once everything's settled and\nwe go back to our own world...\nI'll probably be forcibly recalled...
Wh-why?
Because there's no point to the figurehead anymore.\nIt only worked while I was dressed as a boy.
If they tell me to come back, I have to obey.\nI don't have a choice.
But you don't want to go back, do you?\nThen...!
I wonder...?\nMaybe I don't... have a place.
Not at the Dunois Company...\nnot at IS Academy, where I enrolled by deception...
That's not true...\nAt least, you have one here.\nThe other IS holders think so too.
Thank you...\nI'm glad to hear you say that.\nBut still, there's nothing I can do...
Sorry. That's not like me.\nI'm really fine.
Right now, more than anything,\nwe need to deal with this crisis.
There's got to be a way... surely.
...Thank you.\nYeah. If only there were...
I can't just ignore it...?
What should I do after that...\nIt is my home, in a way.
I don't know what common sense applies\nin Charles-san's world, but...
Couldn't we check with the IS holders\nwho'd know about that sort of thing?
Houki and the others?\n...I wonder...\nI doubt there's a useful solution, but.
Thank you for thinking so hard for me.\nThis is my personal problem, so\nI'll think about it myself.
Come on, instead of worrying about the future,\nlet's think about the next battle.
(...She's trying to handle it on her own...\nBut... if there's anything I can do...)
Y-yeah... IS Academy's\nSpecial Provision 21:\nstudents don't belong to any organization.
So that means they can't forcibly recall me\non those grounds... right?
If that's the case, then... indeed...
But you went out of your way\nto look that up for me.
I actually heard about it.\nThat you were asking around about IS Academy\nfor my sake.
I was so... happy.\nIt moved me a little, that there's\nsomeone like you.
I just wanted to see if I could do something...
Don't be modest.\nI really think it's amazing.
At least, back home,\nI didn't have allies like that...
Thanks.
...Phew.\nI'm glad Charles-san's smiling again.
Huh? My smile...\nSt-stop that, it's embarrassing.
Still, I want Charles-san to keep\nthat cute smile...
C-cute!?\nSaying that out of nowhere is...\nagainst the rules, I think.
And I'm a girl, so\nif you say things like that lightly,\nthere are all sorts of problems.
Th-that's right! It's a problem.\nI'll go around telling everyone\nyou're a womanizer.
If you're saying that to everyone...\nyou'll make enemies, you know?
I won't say weird things anymore...\nSorry...
Ah, so you were...\njust saying stuff...
I really... mean it, though...
Y-you're still... saying that?\nIt's not that I'm unhappy, but...\nI don't know what to do...
Anyway, thank you.\nI'm glad I'll have room to think about\nthe Dunois Company later.
Maybe I'll try to learn from your\nnever-give-up attitude.
Just kidding...\nI'll thank Houki and the others myself.
...Understood.\nIf you're ever troubled again, I'll listen.
Geez, if you say that\nI'll get spoiled...?
I'll solve things myself as much as I can, but...\nI'd like you to at least hear me out again.
Ah... again.\nThis is hard...
Hm? Charles-san?\nWhat's wrong?
N-nothing.\nI-I'm fine. Hahaha...
I-is that so...?\nI heard 'hard'...\nBut I wouldn't be any help...
Th-that's not true!\nIt's really no big deal, so\ndon't get down.
I was just...\npracticing with chopsticks...
Ch-chopsticks...?
Everyone in Japan uses chopsticks, right?\nI want to get used to them quickly.
I can't move them right...
...You seem like you could do anything,\nCharles-san, so an unexpected weakness is surprising...
W-weakness... I have been practicing,\nso I can use them a little now, you know?
Just... not well yet...
But... that's admirable.\nPracticing something you're bad at.
I-is it...?\nSince I came all the way to Japan,\nI should learn the culture.
I can't keep running away\nfrom hard things.
If you used a spoon and fork...\nwouldn't that solve it?
Then I'd stay bad\nat them forever.
If you'd like, could you watch\nhow I use chopsticks...?
Me...?\nSure, I'll give you advice.
...Don't laugh... okay?
I won't laugh.\nIt's fine.
Okay... I'll try.\nHup... ngh.
O-one more time.\n...Ngh.
Try moving the top chopstick,\nthe one pinched between your thumb and index finger.
...Still hard...\nI need more practice...
Um, could you show me how?\nA model to reference might help me\nimprove faster.
M-me...?\nS-sure, but...
Thanks.\nUse these chopsticks.
Understood...\nWatch closely.
Huh...?\nUm... you dropped them?
S-sorry...\nI only studied it in books...\nI'm not good at it either...
...Pfft... heheh...
S-sorry...
Ah! Sorry...\nI shouldn't laugh.\nBut... I see.
Then let's practice together!\nTwo people with the same weakness.\nSo we can overcome it.
...Ah, this is cute.
Heeh, so this kind of outfit is trendy.\nHuh? You go outside in this?
Wow.\nThat's a bit embarrassing for me...
Um... Charles-san?
Huh? Eeeh!!\nH-how long have you been there!?
Wh-whoa, um, this is...\nI just borrowed it and was looking at it.\nR-right! Cecilia lent it to me.
Not like I want anything in it...\nI was just, y'know... curious.
No need to panic...\nThere's nothing weird about looking at\nthat kind of magazine...
R-right.\nIt's not weird... right?
You just startled me, calling out\nall of a sudden...
But you were smiling so happily...\nMaybe I shouldn't have interrupted.\nI'm sorry.
No, no, you're no bother at all.\nBut...\nyou can skip the 'smiling so happily' part...
Was there an outfit in there you wanted?
N-no, nothing.\nI was just looking.
It's got all kinds of styles in it,\nso I thought it was interesting.
Like this one — it's barely different from underwear.\nI could never wear that.
I think it'd look good on you, Charles.
Th-this... no way.\nThat's just... lewd.
I-I'm sorry...
Y-yeah... this one's a bit much.
Even a guy thinks so, huh.\nOnly the model could pull that off,\nI bet.
But...\nfor originality, [NOEL] is...
But...\nfor originality, [MERU] is...
Fair point.\n...\nHmm, to someone from another world, I wonder if MY outfit's the weird one.
Hey, what do you think?
I don't think it comes off as weird.
Oh, good.\nIf you say so, it must be true —\nyou're from another world, after all.
I'm not even sure about that, though...
Oh, sorry.\nRight, you lost your memories.
That was insensitive of me.
It's really fine.\nPlease don't feel bad.
Honestly, with no memories,\nI don't even know if it's a bad thing.
I hope your memories come back\nwhile we're sorting out this whole mess.
If you feel anything coming back, I'll help.
Let's keep doing our best.
Y-yes.\nThe same to you...
(Did I make Charles worry...?\n...She really is kind.)
...This is kinda embarrassing.
Is something wrong?
Oh, uh... no, it's nothing.\nYeah, nothing.
You're the only one I can ask...\nwhich is exactly why it's hard to ask you.
Huh? What do you mean?\nIf it's something I can answer, I'll answer anything.
C-can I ask you something? Just curious.
S-sure... anything.
Promise you won't laugh?
H-huh... I think I'll be fine.
You absolutely, absolutely promise?\nThen... here goes!
(What kind of question needs that much psyching up?)
U-um...\nEveryone always tells me I'm cute,\nbut...
I was wondering what a guy\nwould think...
And you're the only guy around, right?
So... I wanted to hear your take.
M-my opinion...?
It's nothing original, but... I think you're cute.
C-cute... really?\nYou're not lying?
Well, lying wouldn't get me anything.\n...And I'm not smooth enough to lie anyway.
I-I see...\nYeah...\nhearing it from a guy is a little different.
Both make me happy, but\nthey hit different, y'know.
Hit different...?
Huh? Oh, ah!\nN-nothing!\nNever mind.
What about me?
Huh!? Whether you're cute?\nHmm, let me think...
Ah, no, you don't need to think that hard about it...
That was a really precious opinion.\nThanks.
I'm not used to hearing it, but\nI feel a little more confident now.
Well, I'm off.
Hmm... no, that's not it.
What's not it?
Wah! When did you get here!?
Huh? Just now...
R-right.\nTry not to startle me, okay?
What's up?\nEnemies coming!?
No.\nI was just out for a walk and saw you, Charles.
Oh, I see...\nGood, that's a relief.
'Cause if enemies showed up,\nI'd have to leave this as-is.
Um... what are you doing?\nIs that a bento?
Ah, this is... um.\nIt's a prototype.
I've been trying out different things...
Um...\nit's a little embarrassing being stared at like that...
It's a prototype, so giving it to you\nwould be embarrassing.
Huh? Oh, sorry!\nDid I look like I wanted some...?\nThat wasn't my intention.
N-no.\nI'm the one who's sorry.
Oh, that's right!\nWhat do you like to eat,\nwon't you tell me?
Yeah.\nTell me your favorites?\nIt'd really help me out.
Nikujaga... I guess.
Oh, nikujaga.\nThat's real home-style cooking in Japan.\nSo you like that kind of food.
I'd... like to try shark fin.
That might be tough.\nAnd that's not something you like —\nit's something you want to try...
Anyway, this'll do.\nI'll keep it in mind, at least.
Oh, and it's not like I'm saying\nlook forward to it, okay?\nDon't get your hopes up.
O-okay...
Well, I'm heading back to practice...
(Even if she tells me not to expect anything...\nshe's practicing cooking, right?\nNot expecting anything is the hard part...)
Come on, hurry up.
Ch-Charles?\nHuh? That outfit?\nAnd this place...
Come on, let's head to the classroom first.\nStanding around here won't get us anywhere.
Welcome.\nTo Café SHC.
Café SHC?
I'm dressed like this 'cause I'm working here today.\nI mean, what else would it be?
I don't think I've ever shown you\nme dressed like this.
S-so... how do I look?
How do I...?\nI have no idea what's going on...
Not that!\nThis outfit... does it suit me?
Um... yes.\nIt suits you very well.
Really!? Phew —\nif you'd said it didn't, I don't know what I'd've done.
I was gonna go change right away if you had...
Th-then I'll stay in this outfit?
So, about the café...\nwe don't have a menu yet. Is chef's choice okay?
S-sure.\nThat's fine...
Okay!\nJust a sec.
Sorry to keep you waiting.\nThis is...
...This box...\nis it a bento?
Yep. I told you before, right?\nThat I'm working on prototypes...
So I made a bunch of my specialties.\nWhat do you think?
That means...
...Don't make me spell it out.\nI'm a girl too, y'know.
Wh-what!?\nAnyway, let's eat.
Come on, open up.\nI'll feed you.
Huh? You can use chopsticks?
Y-yeah... I practiced.\n'Cause I wanted to do this... y'know.
Anyway, open up.\nSay aaah...
...So, how is it?
It's delicious... really.
Good!\n...My feelings came through, right?
Take your time answering...
Hm...?\nWhere am I...?
Huh?\nYou fell asleep here?\nYou must be tired.
Sorry, did I wake you?
A... dream...\nR-right, of course...
Sorry right after you woke up,\nbut I wanted to give you something.\nHere!
It's a bento.\nI know I told you not to get your hopes up\nwhen you caught me working on prototypes, but...
I want you to try it.
This... could it be...\na continuation of the dream?
Continuation of the dream...?\nWhat do you mean?
You're bad with chopsticks, right?\nI brought a spoon too.
Ah, thank you.\n*nom*... *munch munch*.
So, how is it?\nI want to hear your answer.
(An answer... right.\nMy feelings are...)
Of course, it's fine...\nif I'm good enough...
Huh? That doesn't quite make sense.\nYou mean the bento's okay?\nThat it's good, right?
Yay~.\nWhat a relief.
Ah, relief...?
Oh — I wanted you to taste it first\nas thanks for hearing me out\nabout everything.
And, well, I ended up in a cooking showdown\nwith Houki...\nso it was a taste test for that too...
But it gave me confidence.\nThanks.
You're my precious 'friend'.
...Huh?\nUm... this is... embarrassing...
(And that last 'friend'...\nfelt REALLY emphasized...)
